scope: Public-source locomotion research; repository read only. No Rockstar implementation or proprietary animation assets were accessed or copied.

sources.title: Unity 6 / 6000.0 C# reference — BlendTree inspector

supported_points.point: Unity exposes Compute Thresholds for 1D trees and Compute Positions / Velocity XZ for 2D trees. The speed threshold callback uses Motion.apparentSpeed; X/Z callbacks use Motion.averageSpeed components.
Homogeneous Speed adjusts child timeScale to blendTree.apparentSpeed / clip.apparentSpeed. A zero-speed clip produces a warning asking for root-joint translation curves.

limits: This is official editor source, not a live Unity import or confirmation that the current project is free of foot sliding.

quoted_excerpts.text: ComputeProperty((Motion m, float mirrorMultiplier) => m.apparentSpeed, prop, "speed");

supported_points.point: Animator.SetFloat has overloads with dampTime and deltaTime.
deltaPosition and deltaRotation expose the last evaluated avatar deltas; velocity and angularVelocity expose the last evaluated velocities.
applyRootMotion controls root ownership; CrossFadeInFixedTime and normalized CrossFade are distinct APIs.

quoted_excerpts.text: // Gets the avatar delta position for the last evaluated frame

sources.title: Unity Standard Assets Characters — ThirdPersonMotor example

supported_points.point: The example chooses between scaled Animator.deltaPosition and input-driven speed/direction movement. The input path interpolates ground speed.
Rapid turning is a distinct movement state using heading/input-angle checks.
Jump initiation is gated during turning-around and landing animation states.

limits: The fetched README explicitly targets Unity 2019.3 beta. Use as a historical conceptual example only; do not transplant it into this Unity 6 project.
sources.context_excerpt: This package is intended for use in 2019.3.0f1

rockstar_evidence: No Rockstar / GDC first-party talk could be fetched or verified in this environment. Do not present an invented talk title, link, or claim that RDR2 uses a particular locomotion algorithm. Rockstar-inspired refers to the requested feel, not matching or copying its implementation.
unavailable_sources: The Unity Manual/Learn and GDC sites returned an HTTPS proxy 403; their content was not reviewed.

project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.point: Keep the CharacterController as movement authority for this project, and use measured travel speed to drive animation cadence. Preserve jump, swim, combat, pause, seating and failure guards.
project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.basis: Existing Assets/_DesertShift/Scripts/Player/PlayerMovement.cs owns movement; Animator.applyRootMotion is false. This is an implementation choice for this repository.

project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.point: Use source-measured GaitSpeeds.json, not post-import Motion.apparentSpeed, for these anchored Rocketbox clips.
project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.basis: RocketboxImporter.OnPostprocessAnimation replaces horizontal root curves with constants. Unity BlendTreeInspector warns that speed-based adjustment fails for clips without root translation.

project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.point: Limit cadence compensation to locomotion states with an animation state speed parameter; avoid changing global Animator.speed because that would alter attacks, seating and story clips.
project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.basis: Project-specific design inference based on its shared animator and existing Direction speed parameter; not an official Rockstar statement.

project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.point: Smooth acceleration and turning, separate walk/run/stop thresholds to prevent rapid state toggling, and soften starts/stops without delaying blocked-input cancellation.
project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.basis: Project-specific recommendation; Unity source provides damping/transition controls and the older example separates rapid turns.

project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.point: Validate at different frame rates and ground speeds, including sudden release, 180-degree turns, slopes, crouch, jump/landing, aiming, swimming and activity transitions.
project_specific_inferences_and_recommen.basis: Proposed validation scope; source/API evidence is not proof of live animation quality.
